desc:
Chase real tornadoes in this storm chasing game on a living island! 🌪️

🔧 NEW: CUSTOM CARS! Weld your own storm chaser in your engineering garage: frame it, armour it, bolt on gear and drop anchors to hold against the wind.

Severe weather builds in real time and the whole server shares one sky. Get close to earn more, but stay too long and the twister throws you, your car and the house next door.

🌪️ CHASE: track storms on radar, drop probes, film the tornado and fly a drone into it.
🏚️ WATCH IT HIT: roofs, doors and furniture fly, trees fall and power lines snap.
🚗 DRIVE: eight storm chasers, from the Old Banger to the armoured Tornado Interceptor.
👥 TEAM UP: chase with friends and contain The Big One.
🌩️ EVERY STORM IS DIFFERENT: wedges, ropes, twin tornadoes, night storms, hail and outbreaks.
🏠 BUILD: grow your base with a radar, garage, drone lab and engineering garage.
🧹 HELP OUT: clear fallen trees and rescue survivors.

Stay safe out there, chaser!
